div.span:
1. Configure
SimConfig: seed, region, counts,
rates, pricing, quotas, time
simulator/config.py

2. Provision
deterministic generation,
history back-fill, baseline
generator.py

3. Observe
inventory, topology,
metrics, cost history
inventory.py, network.py

4. Analyse
reachability, IAM graph,
run-rate, anomalies
engines/*

5. Detect
rules + recommendations,
persisted findings
security.py, scan.py

6. Simulate
what-if on an isolated copy
whatif.py

7. Remediate
confirmed, atomic operations
remediation.py, lifecycle.py

8. Verify
full re-scan of changed state
scan.run_scan

9. Compare
before / after, scan diff,
drift vs baseline
drift.py
